description: A fixed classifier maps the source string KOhA to the written KOhA tag. The constituent tag clause and the condition observe that same classification (engine §2, §10).
grammar:
%rule text $w:word %conditions KOhA ⊆ $w.tags, $w.source-text.classify(migration-tags) = KOhA

%rule word $y:A :: $y.source-text.classify(migration-tags)
%classifier migration-tags "KOhA" ∈ KOhA
